rows.label: Household consumption per person, United Kingdom, 2024 (current US$)

source.title: World Bank, World Development Indicators: households and NPISHs final consumption expenditure (NE.CON.PRVT.CD) ÷ population (SP.POP.TOTL), 2024

rows.explainer: What an average person in the United Kingdom consumes in a year, in US dollars at the market rate (a pound amount × @fx.usd_per_gbp_<year> is on the same footing): the base a UK model's ln(consumption) gain is measured against, scaled to its recipients by the model's own share of the mean.
